## Purpose

Explain why a COMPLETED train root has no pull request, and open it for
exactly the head a dry run reported. The train seats a root only once it has
a PR and an approved review of its exact head (`eligible_root_page_on`), so
a root without one never delivers.

## When a playbook uses it

It is a supervisor/operator control (`aq integration redrive-root TASK_ID`),
not a playbook step. The daemon opens missing root PRs itself
(`RootPullRequestReconciler`); the supervisor runs this when a completed root
still has none.

## How it works internally

`_cmd_integration_redrive_root` (`src/commands/integration_commands.py`)
authorizes the caller with `integration_operator` and calls
`RootDeliveryRedrive.run` (`src/integration/root_pull_requests.py`).
`diagnose` reads the task, checkpoint, origin, branch owner and delivery
receipts, then the remote branch tip (`GitManager.aremote_branch_head`) and
whether the head is already on the default branch
(`GitManager.acommits_ahead_of_base`). A childless root is ready when its
leaf checkpoint moved past its origin base; an epic when its aggregate
verification completed. Applying re-runs the diagnosis, refuses a head that
differs from `expected_head_sha` (`changed`), and opens the PR through
`EpicPullRequestService.open_for_epic`.

## Side effects and persistence

A dry run writes nothing and makes only GitHub reads. Applying creates the
GitHub pull request, stores it on `tasks.pr_url`, and logs one
`integration.root_redriven` event carrying the operator, reason, head and
outcome.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

- `not_found` / `not_eligible`: unknown task, not a train project, not a
  root, not COMPLETED, or no integration checkpoint (the legacy completion
  pipeline owns that PR).
- `nothing_to_redrive`: the root already has a PR, was delivered, or its head
  is already on the default branch (a fix-forward merged by hand).
- `blocked`: an epic whose aggregate verification has not completed, a leaf
  whose close recorded no head, an unpublished branch, or a remote branch
  that moved from the recorded head. `reason` names which. Report it; do not
  force it.
- `changed`: the head moved since the dry run. Run the dry run again.

## Example step

```bash
aq integration redrive-root noble-harbor-74
aq integration redrive-root noble-harbor-74 --apply \
  --head 89b28ecd7e5cd052e0416a99d344fae90bf85228 --reason "leaf root closed with no PR"
```
